serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: I will try smoking that fish joint again… I can’t seem to figure out what is preventing me from getting better, I’m completely out of ideas… If Mrs. Fisher says to smoke one out and get some visions I will do just that. I won’t give up that easily! I might’ve gone insane, but all that fishing business is pretty important to me and I’m willing to risk a little. #mrsfisher.Face.Normal You: Mrs. Fisher, could I try smoking the joint again? Mrs. Fisher: Sure. Mrs. Fisher: Remember, no more than one puff. Otherwise, you will hallucinate being chased by mermen for a week. No side effects, by the way… Whatever, she already lit it. No backing out now… You: Here I go… You: Yep… {{wi}}It’s as strong as I remembered… Mrs. Fisher: Could you try to fall on your back this time? It’s difficult to flip you around. You: Wah?
